The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender Doc4739852970, Contract Number 24TW-DC-315OCS (Service Area 1) and 24TW-DC-316OCS (Service Area 2) Description: Restoration of Roads, Sidewalks, and Landscaping to Toronto Water Repairs at Various Locations within the City of Toronto – Service Area 1 for Wards: 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, and 25 (24TW-DC-315OCS) and Service Area 2 for Wards: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 17, and 18 (24TW-DC-316OCS) from December 1, 2024 to November 30, 2025, with the option to extend the agreement for up to one (1) additional separate one (1) year period at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval. Should the option periods be exercised, the General Manager of Toronto Water will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewal under the same terms and conditions.…
